title: A term with more than 2,000 customers still lists them all
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure the shop's own term A is held by 2,500 customers.
  • Make sure Net 30 is active.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the term A row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Scroll the list to the bottom.
  4. Choose "Net 30" in "Move To".
  5. Click the move button.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • A window titled "Move Customers from term A" opens.

Step 3:

  • Every customer is listed, the last in A to Z order at the bottom, with no paging.
  • The count reads 2500 (or 2,500) selected.

Step 4:

  • The button reads "Move 2500 Customers" (or with a comma).

Step 5:

  • The toast reports 2500 (or 2,500) customers moved to Net 30 and term A's Customers count reads 0.
  • All of them moved in this one move (a move has no limit on the number of customers).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)
